command: llvm-mc -triple=x86_64 -filetype=obj P6.asm -o out.o && llvm-objcopy -O binary --only-section=.text out.o out.bin
notes: `movq 16(%rip), %rax` is a literal disp32; `movq L1(%rip), %rcx` and `movq %rdx, L1(%rip)` resolve against L1 at 0x20 (disp 0x12 and 0x09); `movq ext(%rip), %rbx` assembles to 48 8b 1d 00 00 00 00 with R_X86_64_PC32 ext -4, and our pcrel_end with addend 0 is the same value.
